Table QR Sheet

Sab tables ke QR aik sheet mein — print karne ke liye apne browser ya phone ke menu se Print choose karein, har table ka QR alag page par aayega.

Staff Login

Har role ka apna account hai — har waiter ka bhi apna alag account hai, neeche Accounts mein sab ki details dikhti hain. Is per-visitor demo mein koi password nahi hai — sirf apna username aur role select kar ke login karein.

Demo note: Accounts aur data sirf is browser ke localStorage mein hain — koi server login nahi hai.

Accounts

Sab staff accounts — har waiter apne naam/username se alag login karta hai. Kisi account par tap karein, us ki details (username + role) login form mein khud bhar jayengi.
